What's "stale" here — old field values showing up, or the edited item missing entirely from results? And how long after the save did they check — seconds, minutes, next day?

Reason I ask: if search runs off a separate index (Elasticsearch-style) rather than querying the DB live, some lag between save and reindex is expected behavior, not a bug. Without knowing the gap and what specifically looked wrong, I can't tell which one this is.

If you can get even one more detail from the user — how long they waited, whether a refresh/re-search fixed it — that'd settle it. Otherwise this stays a "can't reproduce, no repro steps" ticket, which is fine to log but not something I can size yet.
